parties.respondent: The Principal Secretary, Health and Family Welfare Department, Govt. of NCT of Delhi & Anr.

court_name: Supreme Court of India, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
summary: Issue: interpretation of Rule 3B of the MTP Rules and eligibility for termination of pregnancy for an unmarried woman. Facts: unmarried petitioner ~22 weeks gestation seeks termination; High Court held Rule 3B(c) excludes unmarried women; Supreme Court modified ad interim order, permitting termination if a Medical Board determines safety; proceedings directed AIIMS board and potential termination; central questions involve purposive interpretation of Rule 3B and constitutional grounds (equality, dignity) and international obligations; case subsequently transferred for final decision on Rule 3B interpretation.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 14 of the Constitution of India
